verdict_text:
NO

The plan omits the explicit "exactly 64 tensors were merged" check required by the "Required checks" section — it only asserts total counts of 244 for base/ft1/ft2 and never asserts that the count of tensors matching the MLP regex (the ones actually copied/scaled/summed) is 64. This violates the specification's required-checks clause, which lists that verification as mandatory alongside the shared-tensor and total-count checks.
